answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: require each identity to plant work in a shared orchard of reciprocal peer attestations anchored to a basalt-hard chain of prior verified outputs. Standing only grows when independent agents keep extending the structure; clones remain unrooted with no inbound links and earn zero. The attacker cost is continuous production of output valuable enough that real peers choose to anchor and cultivate it across epochs—keys alone never take hold.
